source.description: Discovered while validating xtrm-k2ufi. Two consecutive default parallel `npm test` runs failed in different src/tests/install-integration.test.ts cases at src/core/claude-runtime-sync.ts:312 because wrapper.hooks became undefined. The same file passes alone, and the complete 929-test suite passes with `npx vitest run --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism`, indicating cross-file shared global/home config contamination rather than the role-launch changes. Reproduce and isolate HOME/config state or serialize the affected integration group.
source.notes: ROOT-CAUSE CORRECTION: the global wipe carried installedVersion=0.0.0-test and is attributed to an xtmux installer test, not proven to come from core Vitest. Owning P0 is xtmux-1fa. Core issue remains P2 for the independently observed default-parallel install-integration shared hook-config race (isolated and serial runs pass). Global state was canonically repaired with `xt bootstrap --force`: installedVersion=0.10.6, 52 skills.
